correctness.rationale: The nondegenerate images of maximal direction-i segments lie in unique direction-(i+1) maximal segments; every direction-(i+1) target must contain an interval image from direction i, because finitely many transverse images and residual points cannot cover an interval. Hence N_(i+1)<=N_i; cycling forces equality, no collapsed sources, a bijection and complete target coverage. Omega limits of a continuous self-map of a compact space are strongly invariant. The H set has two vertical but only one horizontal maximal segment and cannot occur. Finiteness and strong equality F(K)=K are essential.
